note: A. thaliana, reference-prompted 400M. Re-run of results/busco_beam_pilot.json under Table S3 conditions: BUSCO v6.0.0, viridiplantae_odb10 (2024-01-08, n=425), protein mode, hmmsearch 3.4, --offline; proteins extracted with PASA gff3_file_to_proteins.pl (PASApipeline local copy, v2.5.2) against genomes/Athaliana_167_TAIR10.fa. The superseded busco_beam_pilot.json used BUSCO 5.8.3 with gffread protein extraction and reported C 97.6 / F 2.1 / D 97.6 -> S 88.5 / D 9.2, which do not match the 6.0.0 values tabulated in Table S3. 'both' = unfiltered export (standardized_results/A_thaliana_transgenic400Mprompt.gff3, 59,844 transcripts); 'top' = deduplicated first-record-per-locus export (A_thaliana_transgenic400Mprompt_beam1.gff3, 29,922 transcripts). The 'both' row reproduces the Table S3 A. thaliana TransGenic 400M reference-prompted row exactly (416/0/416/8/1/425). Conclusion unchanged: deduplication leaves completeness identical (97.9% either way, F 1.9%, M 0.2%) and only redistributes single-copy vs duplicated, S 0.0/D 97.9 -> S 88.5/D 9.4.
